what.text: This page follows refugees from Syria living in the Netherlands, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 74805 Syrian refugees in the Netherlands, 1.5% of all refugees from Syria.
The largest numbers of Syrian refugees live in Türkiye, Germany, Lebanon and Jordan.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria in every year from 2011 to 2025, at war level in most of them, between the government and Syrian insurgents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Syria from 2013 to 2025, and with the SDF over Rojava Kurdistan territory in some years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 913 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Netherlands.
These are year-end totals for the Netherlands only, reported to UNHCR.
